Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

d4builds S, 2nd in S behind Apocalypse (page "Blazing Scream Warlock (S15)", last updated 2026-09-16; its default variant is labelled "Starter" but carries the full mythic loadout) (https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/); InfinityBuilds Endgame S twice (Yuni "Blazing Scream", Mekuna's Blazing Scream) and Pushing S (JustinFan) (https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list, https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list/pushing); Maxroll Push S (4th of 8) but Endgame A (21st of 38) (https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list, https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list) - the disagreement that puts it second. All read 2026-09-16. Every source tags it mobile/speed-farm (Maxroll pros "Incredibly Mobile"; InfinityBuilds' speed-farm tag; d4builds "TP Speed" variant). It is filed as a hybrid of the Apocalypse meta because the schema needs a meta base; the honest link is Maxroll's Starter profile, which runs Apocalypse and Blazing Scream together - it is otherwise a separately published build with its own engine. Disagreements stated: chest Stealth (d4builds default, InfinityBuilds Yuni) vs a Legendary with Aspect of Diabolical Armor (Maxroll, d4builds "Mythic" variant); gloves Ignition Aspect (d4builds, Maxroll) vs Hand of Apotheosis (InfinityBuilds); ring slot Demonic Aspect (d4builds default) vs Ring of Starless Skies (Maxroll, d4builds Mythic) vs Wendigo Brand (InfinityBuilds); pants Temerity (d4builds default, Maxroll, InfinityBuilds) vs Tibault's Will (d4builds Mythic); helm Leoric's Crown everywhere except Maxroll's plain Endgame profile (Crown of Lucion, "nearly impossible to manage ... without a Ring of Starless Skies"); mercenary Subo + Raheir (d4builds) vs Raheir + Aldkin (Maxroll) vs Varyana + Raheir (InfinityBuilds). Caveat: launch-week lists, no measured live clear yet.

Rotation
  1. Cast Metamorphosis once for permanent Demonform, ride Command Abodian into packs, keep Dark Prison down while fighting and Molten Bomb for Wrath, then spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors so the skulls bounce.
Variants

Leveling — Soul Shard: Legion Shard + Sacrificial Fragment - 'much easier to manage' than Destruction Demon (Maxroll Starter notes, read 2026-09-16). Cast Command Ae'grom to open on a pack; Apocalypse on top of the pack; Command Fallen three times, recast as they expire; Rampage for a tank you can recast to move; spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors so the skulls bounce; Nether Step to escape. Soul Splinters (planner): Splinter of Pain (ring 1), Splinter of Anguish (ring 2), Splinter of the Black Soulstone (amulet). Stat targets for this profile (Maxroll): >40% Attack Speed, >20% Critical Strike Chance, 3x Temper of 'Lucky Hit Restore Resource'. Talisman at this stage: Legendary Horadric Seal with Fer, Phoba and Mlor of Slaughter plus Fer and Phoba of Practiced Technique - 'Fer of Slaughter offers the best of survivability and damage'.
Move on when Swap when you have Elegy (Lord Zir) and Moloch's Beating Flame: respec to Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment and Metamorphosis (Destruction Demon), and put Sadistic or Undying Aspect on boots first for healing.

Early Endgame — Soul Shard: Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment. Maxroll Midgame notes (read 2026-09-16): ride Command Abodian into packs (breaks crowd control, Unstoppable); cast Metamorphosis once and never again unless it drops; Dark Prison only while fighting (kills inside reset it); Molten Bomb for resource; Rampage to move and to tag elites for Anathema of the Primes; spam Blazing Scream into terrain; stay close for Inferno Fragment's burn. Midgame floors (Maxroll): >70% Attack Speed, >60% Critical Strike Chance. Soul Splinters: Greater Splinter of Pain (ring 1), Greater Splinter of Anguish (ring 2), Greater Splinter of the Black Soulstone (amulet). Talisman at this stage: Legendary Horadric Seal (Critical Strike Chance) with Linta, Phoba, Berú, Fer and Mlor of Abaddon's Flesh plus Anathema of the Primes - 'Phoba of Abaddon's Flesh is the strongest scaling set charm'.
Move on when Swap when Leoric's Crown drops and you can fill it with two splinters, and Stealth is crafted with its teleport power (d4builds: craft three and cube 3-to-1 for the TP Enigma power).

Late Endgame — Soul Shard: Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment. Metamorphosis once; ride Command Abodian between packs; Dark Prison when fighting; Molten Bomb for Wrath; spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors; Nether Step or Stealth's teleport to reposition (d4builds bar + Maxroll notes, read 2026-09-16). d4builds' note 'Use Destruction Splinter' refers to the Splinter of Evil from Baal (seasonal power). Soul Splinters (d4builds; Abyssal tier per Maxroll's endgame planner): Abyssal Splinter of Pain + Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone in Leoric's Crown, Abyssal Splinter of Lies (ring 1 - a farming pick: its drawback leaves you always Weakened and Vulnerable), Abyssal Splinter of Sin (ring 2), Abyssal Splinter of Anguish (amulet). Five splinters against Blizzard's 'up to three among available Jewelry slots' - Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry; recorded as published, re-verify. Gems: d4builds writes 'Ruby' on Elegy and the focus; the planner's grade (Horadric Ruby) is recorded. d4builds lists 'Ruby x2' on Elegy, which a one-handed sword cannot hold - recorded as one socket.
Move on when Move to the pushing cut once Ring of Starless Skies drops (it offsets the resource cost of Abyssal Splinter of Anguish, Maxroll) and you have at least four Rite of the Nameless charms.

Pushing — The late-endgame loop with Sigil of Subversion on the bar in place of Nether Step. Items follow d4builds' 'Mythic' variant, which matches Maxroll's 'Leoric Crown' profile item for item except pants and splinters. Pants: d4builds Mythic wears Tibault's Will - overruled by its own default variant, Maxroll and InfinityBuilds, all of which wear Temerity. Soul Splinters (d4builds Mythic): Abyssal Splinter of Pain + Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone in Leoric's Crown, Abyssal Splinter of Lies (ring 1), Abyssal Splinter of Sin (ring 2), Abyssal Splinter of Anguish (amulet). For pushing prefer Maxroll's split, which avoids Lies' permanent Weakened/Vulnerable drawback: Black Soulstone + Anguish in the helm, Abyssal Splinter of Pain on Ring of Starless Skies, Abyssal Splinter of Damnation on The Eightfold Idol, Abyssal Splinter of the Mother on the amulet. Stat floors: see the build's stat requirements (Maxroll 'Leoric Crown' notes).

Stat requirements
  • 100% Attack Speed
  • 100% Critical Strike Chance
  • >10 Wrath Regeneration
  • 2x Temper of 'Lucky Hit Restore Resource'
  • >10,000 Fire Resistance

How to run them

d4builds default variant (read 2026-09-16); its mercenary tree is encoded, so no hired-skill picks are listed. d4builds' Mythic variant and Maxroll hire Raheir (Maxroll picks Provoke, Shield Charge, Raheir's Guard, Iron Wolf's Ward) with Aldkin (Field of Languish; d4builds Mythic opportunity 'Skill Cast'); InfinityBuilds hires Varyana with Raheir's Bastion reinforcement. Maxroll: 'Raheir's Bastion is a super safe and reliable way of surviving dangerous boss mechanics.'

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

d4builds S, 2nd in S behind Apocalypse (page "Blazing Scream Warlock (S15)", last updated 2026-09-16; its default variant is labelled "Starter" but carries the full mythic loadout) (https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/); InfinityBuilds Endgame S twice (Yuni "Blazing Scream", Mekuna's Blazing Scream) and Pushing S (JustinFan) (https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list, https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list/pushing); Maxroll Push S (4th of 8) but Endgame A (21st of 38) (https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list, https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list) - the disagreement that puts it second. All read 2026-09-16. Every source tags it mobile/speed-farm (Maxroll pros "Incredibly Mobile"; InfinityBuilds' speed-farm tag; d4builds "TP Speed" variant). It is filed as a hybrid of the Apocalypse meta because the schema needs a meta base; the honest link is Maxroll's Starter profile, which runs Apocalypse and Blazing Scream together - it is otherwise a separately published build with its own engine. Disagreements stated: chest Stealth (d4builds default, InfinityBuilds Yuni) vs a Legendary with Aspect of Diabolical Armor (Maxroll, d4builds "Mythic" variant); gloves Ignition Aspect (d4builds, Maxroll) vs Hand of Apotheosis (InfinityBuilds); ring slot Demonic Aspect (d4builds default) vs Ring of Starless Skies (Maxroll, d4builds Mythic) vs Wendigo Brand (InfinityBuilds); pants Temerity (d4builds default, Maxroll, InfinityBuilds) vs Tibault's Will (d4builds Mythic); helm Leoric's Crown everywhere except Maxroll's plain Endgame profile (Crown of Lucion, "nearly impossible to manage ... without a Ring of Starless Skies"); mercenary Subo + Raheir (d4builds) vs Raheir + Aldkin (Maxroll) vs Varyana + Raheir (InfinityBuilds). Caveat: launch-week lists, no measured live clear yet.

Rotation
  1. Cast Metamorphosis once for permanent Demonform, ride Command Abodian into packs, keep Dark Prison down while fighting and Molten Bomb for Wrath, then spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors so the skulls bounce.
Variants

Leveling — Soul Shard: Legion Shard + Sacrificial Fragment - 'much easier to manage' than Destruction Demon (Maxroll Starter notes, read 2026-09-16). Cast Command Ae'grom to open on a pack; Apocalypse on top of the pack; Command Fallen three times, recast as they expire; Rampage for a tank you can recast to move; spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors so the skulls bounce; Nether Step to escape. Soul Splinters (planner): Splinter of Pain (ring 1), Splinter of Anguish (ring 2), Splinter of the Black Soulstone (amulet). Stat targets for this profile (Maxroll): >40% Attack Speed, >20% Critical Strike Chance, 3x Temper of 'Lucky Hit Restore Resource'. Talisman at this stage: Legendary Horadric Seal with Fer, Phoba and Mlor of Slaughter plus Fer and Phoba of Practiced Technique - 'Fer of Slaughter offers the best of survivability and damage'.
Move on when Swap when you have Elegy (Lord Zir) and Moloch's Beating Flame: respec to Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment and Metamorphosis (Destruction Demon), and put Sadistic or Undying Aspect on boots first for healing.

Early Endgame — Soul Shard: Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment. Maxroll Midgame notes (read 2026-09-16): ride Command Abodian into packs (breaks crowd control, Unstoppable); cast Metamorphosis once and never again unless it drops; Dark Prison only while fighting (kills inside reset it); Molten Bomb for resource; Rampage to move and to tag elites for Anathema of the Primes; spam Blazing Scream into terrain; stay close for Inferno Fragment's burn. Midgame floors (Maxroll): >70% Attack Speed, >60% Critical Strike Chance. Soul Splinters: Greater Splinter of Pain (ring 1), Greater Splinter of Anguish (ring 2), Greater Splinter of the Black Soulstone (amulet). Talisman at this stage: Legendary Horadric Seal (Critical Strike Chance) with Linta, Phoba, Berú, Fer and Mlor of Abaddon's Flesh plus Anathema of the Primes - 'Phoba of Abaddon's Flesh is the strongest scaling set charm'.
Move on when Swap when Leoric's Crown drops and you can fill it with two splinters, and Stealth is crafted with its teleport power (d4builds: craft three and cube 3-to-1 for the TP Enigma power).

Late Endgame — Soul Shard: Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment. Metamorphosis once; ride Command Abodian between packs; Dark Prison when fighting; Molten Bomb for Wrath; spam Blazing Scream into walls and corridors; Nether Step or Stealth's teleport to reposition (d4builds bar + Maxroll notes, read 2026-09-16). d4builds' note 'Use Destruction Splinter' refers to the Splinter of Evil from Baal (seasonal power). Soul Splinters (d4builds; Abyssal tier per Maxroll's endgame planner): Abyssal Splinter of Pain + Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone in Leoric's Crown, Abyssal Splinter of Lies (ring 1 - a farming pick: its drawback leaves you always Weakened and Vulnerable), Abyssal Splinter of Sin (ring 2), Abyssal Splinter of Anguish (amulet). Five splinters against Blizzard's 'up to three among available Jewelry slots' - Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry; recorded as published, re-verify. Gems: d4builds writes 'Ruby' on Elegy and the focus; the planner's grade (Horadric Ruby) is recorded. d4builds lists 'Ruby x2' on Elegy, which a one-handed sword cannot hold - recorded as one socket.
Move on when Move to the pushing cut once Ring of Starless Skies drops (it offsets the resource cost of Abyssal Splinter of Anguish, Maxroll) and you have at least four Rite of the Nameless charms.

Pushing — The late-endgame loop with Sigil of Subversion on the bar in place of Nether Step. Items follow d4builds' 'Mythic' variant, which matches Maxroll's 'Leoric Crown' profile item for item except pants and splinters. Pants: d4builds Mythic wears Tibault's Will - overruled by its own default variant, Maxroll and InfinityBuilds, all of which wear Temerity. Soul Splinters (d4builds Mythic): Abyssal Splinter of Pain + Abyssal Splinter of the Black Soulstone in Leoric's Crown, Abyssal Splinter of Lies (ring 1), Abyssal Splinter of Sin (ring 2), Abyssal Splinter of Anguish (amulet). For pushing prefer Maxroll's split, which avoids Lies' permanent Weakened/Vulnerable drawback: Black Soulstone + Anguish in the helm, Abyssal Splinter of Pain on Ring of Starless Skies, Abyssal Splinter of Damnation on The Eightfold Idol, Abyssal Splinter of the Mother on the amulet. Stat floors: see the build's stat requirements (Maxroll 'Leoric Crown' notes).

Stat requirements
  • 100% Attack Speed
  • 100% Critical Strike Chance
  • >10 Wrath Regeneration
  • 2x Temper of 'Lucky Hit Restore Resource'
  • >10,000 Fire Resistance

Reasoning

Based onApocalypse Warlock
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Same Hellfire/Volatility chassis as the Apocalypse meta (Moloch's Beating Flame, Leoric's Crown with two splinters, Dark Prison, Soul Splinters), but the damage engine moves from Apocalypse to Blazing Scream: Maxroll's own Blazing Scream Starter profile runs Apocalypse and Blazing Scream together on Legion Shard, which is the bridge this build's leveling stage uses (planner to4erl0e, 2026-09-16).
  2. Soul Shard swaps Ritualist/Scorching for Vanguard Shard + Inferno Fragment, and Metamorphosis with Destruction Demon gives permanent Demonform at the cost of continuous self-burn (Maxroll guide).
  3. Hands of the Worldbreaker, Fleshwrit Carapace and Scepter of the Three are dropped for Elegy (3.2.1: Blazing Scream becomes an Archfiend Skill, 30-50%), Infernal Homunculus, The Eightfold Idol and Temerity.
  4. Talisman changes from Rite of the Nameless to Flesh of Abaddon's charms (plus Fists of Fate), because Blazing Scream is a Demonology/Hellfire spender rather than a Sigil caster.
  5. Mobility-first: Stealth's teleport, Command Abodian (Unhindered, 3.2.1) and Nether Step make it the forgiving farm build; the pushing stage re-adds Sigil of Subversion and a 4+2 set split for damage.
